purpose: Determine whether the explicitly MIT, Codex-only historical revision of RangaPrasath/coding-sessions provides a duplicate-safe native-session-derived coordinate before any browser-tool count or overlap statistic is computed.

source.revision_selection_basis: Dataset history places e37635a after the Codex export and dataset-card/license commit and before 9745612, which added six OpenCode sessions. Revision selection does not use tool content or browser activity.
dataset_card_required_declarations: 73 real coding sessions from OpenAI Codex

exporter.codex_plugin_semantics: Each Codex rollout JSONL is loaded as one CanonicalSession; session_meta.payload.id becomes CanonicalSession.id, falling back to path-derived ID only when absent.
exporter.anonymizer_semantics: One fresh salt is used for the export batch and each session.id is deterministically SHA-256 salted then truncated to 16 hex characters; equality/distinctness within the batch is therefore preserved while original UUIDs are removed.
exporter.exporter_commit_selection_basis: Latest audited pi-brain commit before the dataset export date; package version remains 0.1.0.

ingestion.session_row_definition: top-level object with nonempty id, source, and messages array

pass_requires: historical revision resolves and dataset card matches frozen MIT/Codex-only declarations
all 73 ids match the frozen pi-brain anonymized-id pattern
decision_rule.pass_authorizes_only: A separate preregistered count-only screen for the source-native Codex first-party web-search tool.
